sources.snippet: Cosmos-H-Dreams Real-time action-conditioned surgical video simulation via WebRTC, built on FlashDreams. Overview Cosmos-H-Dreams is a fine-tuned variant of Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, with its own checkpoint and a serving layer in a streaming server, enabling live surgical simulation driven by keyboard or Meta Quest controller input.
